issues.description: Transport-level httpx errors are not retried or wrapped, so transient network failures escape the typed client API.
Retry-After parsing only accepts numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date retry headers.
Malformed paginated success bodies can be silently treated as empty results instead of raising an API error.
Path parameters are interpolated without percent-encoding, so reserved characters in IDs can change the requested route.
Successful responses are parsed with bare json/key access, causing JSONDecodeError or KeyError instead of contextual LumenAPIError failures.
Batch item results do not validate status or task/error consistency, allowing impossible states into public models.
ReviewResult does not validate verdict values despite exposing a restricted Verdict type.
Scripted mock responses bypass API-key validation, which can mask authentication regressions in tests.
httpx dependency has no upper bound, leaving the client exposed to future incompatible major releases.
Typed package does not ship a py.typed marker, so downstream type checkers may not treat it as typed.
Package version is duplicated separately from pyproject.toml and can drift.
